overview.text: CheapTokens offers discounted same-day Venice AI API credits through a direct Venice key and states that it is independent of Venice. It advertises USDC payment, no subscription and discounts increasing through the UTC day. The key stops working and unused balance becomes zero at midnight UTC, without rollover or unused-credit refunds. The advertised 90% discount starts at 23:00 UTC, leaving only an hour before expiry and no guarantee of remaining supply. Card fees may apply. Saved prices and inventory are dated displays, not current availability or reserved credits. Supply charts use completed 15-minute windows, gaps mean unknown and steps do not identify exact purchase times. Recent purchases are not an instant complete sales feed. Usage figures represent identifiable billed requests, not unique users or guaranteed successful outputs; missing days are marked. Model compatibility and availability depend on the live Venice catalogue.
